limitations: Function starts and ends remain candidates; indirect control flow and jump tables are not guessed.
Root graph includes address-taken prologues, not just executable paths from entry.
Heuristic expansion can decode data or choose the wrong mode; see conflicts and confidence.
General memory loads remain symbolic. No runtime load address or SDK layout is assumed.
IT blocks and unsupported PC writes terminate analysis explicitly.
No original binary is executed; no historical network endpoint is contacted.
